decisionRule: KEEP = shipped as-is from the chosen base. PORT = verified capability moved from another version. REFACTOR = restructured during merge. MERGE = combined implementations. REPLACE = superseded by a better implementation. ARCHIVE = retained as history, not active code. REJECT = dropped with reasons.
